record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II
record.original_question: Can the detailed asymptotic formulas proposed by Borot, Eynard, Majumdar, and Nadal for Tracy–Widom distributions of general β-ensembles be verified rigorously for all β>0?

evidence.quote: It is a challenging open problem to verify rigorously these formulae of Borot et al.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\beta>0$. For each $N\ge 1$, let $\lambda_{\max}^{(N,\beta)}$ denote the largest eigenvalue of the Gaussian $\beta$-ensemble of size $N$ — that is, the joint density on $\mathbb{R}^N$ proportional to
$$\prod_{1\le i<j\le N}|\lambda_i-\lambda_j|^{\beta}\,\exp\Big(-\tfrac{\beta N}{4}\sum_{i=1}^N \lambda_i^2\Big).$$
It is known that the rescaled top eigenvalue $N^{2/3}(\lambda_{\max}^{(N,\beta)}-2)$ converges in distribution to a limiting law $F_\beta$, the general-$\beta$ Tracy–Widom distribution (which for $\beta=1,2,4$ recovers the classical Tracy–Widom laws).

Heuristic loop-equation/topological-expansion arguments propose a detailed all-orders asymptotic expansion for the right tail of $F_\beta$ of the form
$$1-F_\beta(t) \;\sim\; \frac{C_\beta}{t^{3\beta/4}}\,\exp\!\Big(-\tfrac{2}{3}\beta\, t^{3/2}\Big)\,\Big(1+\sum_{k\ge 1}\frac{a_k(\beta)}{t^{3k/2}}\Big)\qquad (t\to +\infty),$$
together with a corresponding all-orders expansion of the left tail as $t\to -\infty$, with explicit coefficients $C_\beta$ and $a_k(\beta)$ produced by the loop-equation recursion.

Problem. Establish these proposed asymptotic expansions for the tails of $F_\beta$ rigorously, for every $\beta>0$.
artifact.status_search_result: The leading-order right tail exponent of the general-$\beta$ Tracy–Widom law was proved rigorously by Dumaz and Virág (2013) via the stochastic Airy operator. Rigorous all-orders expansions are known for the classical cases $\beta=1,2,4$ (and $\beta=6$ via Calogero–Painlevé/Riemann–Hilbert methods of Bertola–Cafasso–Rubtsov and Grava–Its–Kapaev–Mezzadri). However, the full detailed all-orders asymptotic expansions conjectured by Borot–Eynard–Majumdar–Nadal for general $\beta>0$ have not been rigorously established in full generality; the problem remains open in this stronger form.

status_evidence.title: The right tail exponent of the Tracy-Widom-beta distribution (Dumaz–Virág)
status_evidence.snippet: Rigorous proof of the leading right-tail exponent of TW_beta for all beta>0 via the stochastic Airy operator.
status_evidence.claim: Leading right-tail asymptotic of F_beta rigorously established for all beta>0.

status_evidence.title: Right tail expansion of Tracy-Widom beta laws (Borot–Nadal)
status_evidence.snippet: All-orders heuristic asymptotic expansion of the right tail of TW_beta via loop equations.
status_evidence.claim: The all-orders expansion is given as a (non-rigorous) physical derivation.

status_evidence.title: On the Tracy-Widom_beta distribution for beta=6
status_evidence.snippet: Riemann-Hilbert/Calogero-Painlevé analysis providing rigorous asymptotic information for beta=6.
status_evidence.claim: Rigorous progress beyond beta=1,2,4 exists for specific values of beta.
